mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees under a Waning Crescent moon at Verona Area High School. We have a moderate air quality index of 54 today, and the overnight low will drop to 70 degrees with rain predicted.

The Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects at 201 South Main Street, and the City Clerk has wrapped up voting for the student-designed I Voted stickers, with winners to be announced for the November election.
Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga, while tomorrow is a huge day for trivia fans with events at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the downtown farmer's market.
On August 5, police were called to the 500 block of Whalen Road to arrest a man for a probation violation warrant after he attempted to flee officers.
Today's flavor is Georgia Peach. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow.
